recipes.name: 10 Levels of Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 2 pkg Blue Box Mac & Cheese macaroni
2 pkg Blue Box cheese powder packets
12 oz plant starch coated shredded cheese
1 pound mac & cheese, refrigerated until firm
6 oz mild yellow cheddar, freshly grated
1/2 tsp sodium citrate, more as needed
freshly ground black pepper, to taste
For the Homemade Mac Tteok Bokki Hybrid
8 oz parmesan, freshly and finely grated
220 g (8 oz) shredded cheeses of choice
freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: For Level 3: Blue Box Plus:
For the Mac
Bring water to boil in a medium saucepan and add macaroni. Cook according to box instructions or until tender. - 12 cups water - 2 pkg Blue Box Mac & Cheese macaroni
Meanwhile, make cheese sauce in a separate saucepan.
For the Cheese Sauce

In a separate saucepan over medium-low heat, combine butter, milk, paprika, dried garlic, and ground mustard. Stir and cook until melted and homogeneous. - ½ paprika - ½ dried garlic - ½ ground mustard - ½ cup milk - 8 tbsp salted butter cut up
For the Assembly
Preheat oven to 375 °F.
Once the cheese sauce is completely melted and the pasta cooked, drain pasta, do not rinse and return to the pot. - For the Mac
Then add Blue Box cheese packets and melted cheese sauce. Stir to combine and transfer to cast iron casserole dish. - 2 pkg Blue Box cheese powder packets

Combine melted butter and crushed cornflakes in a mixing bowl then sprinkle evenly over top of the mac and cheese and bake in a preheated oven for about 25 to 30 minutes or until the crushed corn flakes are brown and crispy. - 2 tbsp melted butter - 1 cup crushed corn flakes
For Level 4: Evaporated Milk:
Bring water to boil in a medium saucepan and add macaroni. Cook according to box instructions or until tender. - 12 oz cooked macaroni
Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of pasta water, do not rinse and return to the pot. Set aside for later use. - 1 cup reserved pasta water
For the Cheese Sauce
In a large saucepan over medium heat add evaporated milk and heat gently. - 12 fl oz (1 can) evaporated milk
Then reduce the heat to low, add shredded cheese and gently whisk to combine until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth. - 12 oz plant starch coated shredded cheese
For the Assembly
Add the Cheese Sauce to the cooked macaroni along with ¼ cup of pasta water to start, using more pasta water as needed for a homogenous mixture. - cooked macaroni - ¼ cup reserved pasta water
Stir using a rubber spatula until thoroughly combined. Serve hot.
For Level 5: One Pot inspired by America's Test Kitchen:
In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine whole milk and water. Cover and bring to a rolling simmer. - 1 ½ cup whole milk - 1 cup water
Then, add elbow macaroni. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until the macaroni is cooked and the milk mixture is mostly absorbed. - 8 oz elbow macaroni
Kill the heat, then add the shredded cheeses. Stir to combine. - 8 slices yellow American cheese shredded - 4 oz sharp cheddar shredded & divided
Add cayenne pepper and Dijon mustard and stir to combine. The cheese sauce should be nice and gooey at this point. - ¼ tsp cayenne pepper - ½ tsp Dijon mustard
Then add the remaining shredded cheddar, mix until just combined, cover and allow the cheese to melt, about 3-5 minutes. - sharp cheddar shredded & divided
Serve hot with a sprinkling of freshly ground black pepper.
For Level 6: Deep Fried Mac & Cheese:
Cut baked mac & cheese into 2 x 2 inch (5 x 5 cm) squares. - 1 pound mac & cheese refrigerated until firm

Then, set up your dredging station in wide shallow bowls with all-purpose flour, beaten eggs with a drop of cold water, and panko bread crumbs. - 2 all purpose flour - 4 eggs beaten - 2 cups panko bread crumbs
Meanwhile, fill a high-walled pan with frying oil around 2/3rds of the way full. Heat to 350 °F (175 °C). - frying oil
Transfer the dredged mac & cheese squares to the frying oil, frying one at a time until crispy and golden brown.
Set the fried mac & cheese squares on a racked rimmed baking sheet to drain. Repeat with all mac & cheese squares, maintaining the frying oil temperature as necessary.
Serve the mac & cheese squares stacked and skewered on a shallow dish of ranch dressing, drizzling with ketchup as desired. - ranch dressing as desired - ketchup optional
For Level 7: Classic Mornay:
For the Prep

Shred mild yellow cheddar, Gouda, and parmigiano reggiano then combine in a mixing bowl. Set aside. - 6 oz mild yellow cheddar freshly grated - 2 oz Gouda freshly grated - 2 oz parmigiano reggiano freshly grated
Cook macaroni according to box instructions, drain, and set aside. - 8 oz cooked macaroni
For the Sauce
In a high-walled medium sauté pan over medium-low heat, combine butter and flour. Whisk into a paste for 1-3 minutes until the raw flour dissipates. - 2 tbsp salted butter - 2 tbsp all purpose flour

Increase heat to medium. Then, add cold whole milk a splash at a time, about 1 tbsp, whisking constantly and making sure to fully incorporate each splash of milk into the flour mixture before adding another splash. - 2 cups cold whole milk
Continue to add milk and whisk until the mixture begins to thicken to a smooth sauce, then you can add more milk as the Béchamel forms.
Once all of the milk is combined, increase the heat to medium high and slowly bring to a bare, gentle simmer. Cook for about 3 minutes.
Then kill the heat, stir in the cheeses with a rubber spatula, and allow the residual heat to melt cheeses into a thick cheese sauce.
Combine Mornay sauce with the cooked macaroni and serve immediately.
For Level 8: Molecular Gastronomy - Sodium Citrate:
Grate cheeses and transfer to a large mixing bowl. - 12 oz cheddar cheese - 2 oz pecorino romano cheese
In a saucepan over medium-low heat, bring milk to a boil. - 1 cup milk
Transfer grated cheese to the blender and add Dijon mustard, grated pecorino romano cheese, and cayenne pepper. - ½ tsp Dijon mustard - ½ tsp cayenne pepper
Once the milk is just boiling, reduce heat to low and add sodium citrate. Tiny whisk until sodium citrate is dissolved. - ½ tsp sodium citrate more as needed
Then, begin blending the cheese mixture on low speed. Slowly pour the milk mixture into the blender, increasing speed as you pour. - 1 cup milk
Blend until a thick, creamy cheese sauce has formed.
Combine with cooked cavatappi pasta and serve immediately. - 12 oz cooked cavatappi pasta
For Level 9: Sparing No Expense:
For the Lobster Tail
Gently cut and remove the meat from the shell and chop into bite-sized pieces. - 1 lobster tail shelled
In a small saucepan over medium heat, melt TKTK butter and poach the lobster, stirring frequently, until tender and fragrant. - 6 Italian butter - lobster tail shelled
Set aside for later use, reserving melted butter.
Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package instructions. - 12 oz Busiate pasta cooked
For the Cheese Sauce
In a large saucepan over medium-low heat, add reserved Italian butter from poaching the lobster. Then add flour and whisk until paste-like. - 1 ½ tbsp Italian butter reserved - 1 tbsp flour

Increase heat to medium. Then, add cold whole milk a splash at a time, about 1 tbsp, whisking constantly and making sure to fully incorporate each splash of milk into the flour mixture before adding another splash. - 1 cup milk
Once all of the milk is combined, increase the heat to medium high and slowly bring to a bare, gentle simmer.
Add grated cheese and poached lobster, and stir to combine. Cook until the cheese is melted and the lobster is heated through. - 12 oz various expensive cheeses grated - Poached Lobster Tail
For the Assembly
Combine cooked pasta, cheese sauce, and lobster. Mix until evenly coated.

Serve immediately with chives for garnish and freshly ground black pepper finishing with freshly shaved truffle. - chive finely minced - freshly ground black pepper to taste - Summer Burgundy Truffle freshly shaved
For Level 10: Michelin Moves:
For the Homemade Mac-Tteok-Bokki Hybrid
For the Tangzhong Starter

In a heat-proof mixing bowl, combine rice flour and boiling water and mix until it forms a thick, gloopy paste. Set aside and allow to cool completely before incorporating in the pasta dough. - 30 g rice flour - 90 g boiling water
For the Pasta Dough

In the bowl of a stand mixer, combine semolina flour, white rice flour, tapioca starch, and kosher salt. Whisk until homogenous. - 300 g semolina flour - 90 g white rice flour - 60 g tapioca starch - 5 g kosher salt
Then add cold Tangzhong starter, pressing it through a mesh sieve to ensure a smooth mixture. - Tangzhong Starter
Add vegetable oil and egg mixture to the bowl. - 10 g vegetable oil - 2 large whole eggsbeaten
Then knead with the dough hook on medium speed until the mixture starts to come together in one cohesive dough ball.
Wrap in plastic wrap and let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes. The dough may require kneading by hand The dough is finished resting when it is supple to the touch and no longer crumbly.
Using the macaroni attachment, begin feeding golf ball-sized pasta dough balls to make the macaroni. Use a floured baking sheet to catch the macaroni as it is cut. - semolina flour for dusting
Toss the cut macaroni in the semolina flour and set aside.
Feel free to test the macaroni by boiling it in a pot of water for 2 minutes
For the Parmesan Broth

In a large pot, combine chicken broth, water, thyme, shallots, garlic cloves, bay leaves, and parmesan cheese rinds. - 2 cups chicken stock - 2 cups water - bundle of thyme - 2 shallots halved - 2 cloves garlic - 2 bay leaves - 3 ½ parmesan rinds
Simmer for an hour. While the broth is simmering, make the breadcrumbs
For the Breadcrumbs
Preheat oven to 375°F with convection.
Slice the baguette and then tear the soft inside into bite-sized crumbles. - 1 loaf high quality baguette
Transfer to a mixing bowl and drizzle with olive oil. - olive oil as needed
Then, transfer to a baking sheet and place in the preheated oven for 10-15 minutes, tossing every few minutes to ensure even toasting.
While the breadcrumbs are toasting, make the cheese sauce.
When the breadcrumbs are finished toasting, set aside.
For the Parmesan Cheese Crisps
Preheat oven to 400 °F

On a parchment lined baking sheet, grate the parmesan cheese very finely into 2 separate piles then transfer to the preheated oven for time until crispy and golden brown. - 8 oz parmesan freshly and finely grated

While the cheese crisps are in the oven, prepare your stove top for the Cheese Sauce and the Mac & Cheese Assembly with a medium pot filled with the parmesan broth, a medium sauté pan, and a large pot.
For the Cheese Sauce
In a high-walled medium sauté pan over medium heat, combine butter and flour. Whisk into a paste for 1-3 minutes until the raw flour dissipates. - 1 tbsp butter - 1 tbsp all purpose flour
In a separate saucepan over medium-low heat, add milk and sodium citrate. Whisk until the sodium citrate is dissolved. - 1 cup whole milk - ¼ tsp sodium citrate

Then, return the milk mixture to a spouted measuring cup before adding to the roux 1 splash at a time, about 1 tbsp, whisking constantly and making sure to fully incorporate each splash of milk into the flour mixture before adding another splash.
Simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, then kill the heat and add the shredded cheeses. Stir and melt using the residual heat and a rubber spatula. - 220 g (8 oz) shredded cheeses of choice
Meanwhile, bring the Parmesan Broth to a boil.
For the Assembly

Boil the Homemade Mac-Tteok-Bokki Hybrid for 90 seconds in the Parmesan Broth. Strain gently and transfer to the cheese sauce with a few teaspoons of the Parmesan Broth. Mix to combine. - Homemade Mac Tteok Bokki Hybrid - Parmesan Broth
Serve immediately and top with cheese crisps, bread crumbs, chives, and freshly ground black pepper. - Cheese Crisps - Breadcrumbs - chives freshly chopped - freshly ground black pepper to taste
